description: Two attenuverters, each scaling and inverting one signal

params.text: Scales that channel's input from -100% to +100%: full level clockwise, inverted full level anticlockwise, silence at centre

inputs.text: The signal that channel's knob scales; with nothing patched the knob scales a fixed 5V instead

outputs.text: That channel's input multiplied by its knob setting

notes: A polyphonic cable carries at most four channels through this module, and each channel has its own voice count.
